values.note: $30 per single site (standard, RV and equestrian), $60 double site; two vehicles included, $10 per extra vehicle. Same in the 2027 rate table. Cash, check or money order in the self-service fee tube.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/alvarado-campground ('Single Site: $30 per night', 'Double Site: $60 per night', 'Two vehicles per site. Additional $10 fee for extra vehicles'; page last updated February 3, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234105/rates (2026 and 2027 seasons: STANDARD/RV/EQUESTRIAN NONELECTRIC 30, double 60), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Forest Service: 'Early May to late September', weather dependent. 2026 dates are recreation.gov's fee seasons (first-come May 8-14, reservable May 15 - Sept 19, first-come Sept 20-26).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/alvarado-campground ('Seasons of Use: Early May to late September'; 'This campground is open early May to late September, weather dependent.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234105/rates (2026 seasons 2026-05-08 to 2026-09-26), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234105 (notice 'No electric hookups available') + campsite catalog for 234105 (every site NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup No, Sewer Hookup No), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Catalog: 42 standard/RV sites (27 reservable, 15 first-come), 5 walk-to tent sites on the upper level, 3 equestrian sites (no corrals). Max vehicle lengths 18-45 ft, about half 30 ft or more; two pull-throughs. Dirt and gravel aprons; one RV or two vehicles per site.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234105 (site types, reservable flag, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry; 1 management site excluded) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234105 ('The lower level accommodates tents and RVs, the upper level is designed for walk-in tent campers, and part of the middle section caters to equestrian campers. There are no corrals'; 'Parking aprons are dirt and gravel'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Hand pump / spigot for filling jugs only: do not attach RV hoses. Firewood sold at the host site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/alvarado-campground ('Restrooms: Accessible outhouses'; 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234105 (notices 'There is No Dump Station in this campground', 'Please DO NOT attach your RV hoses to the water systems'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov for the 2026 peak season May 15 - Sept 19; the weeks either side are first-come, and 15 standard sites are always first-come (must be occupied the first night). recreation.gov closes booking 4 days before arrival. 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday-weekend minimums (not marked soft). 14 nights in any 30.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234105 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days', maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4; notice 'This facility has first-come, first-served sites') + /rates (2026 Peak Season 05-15 to 09-19, First-come First-served Seasons 05-08 to 05-14 and 09-20 to 09-26) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/alvarado-campground ('reservable, equestrian and first-come, first-served sites'; 'First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the first night'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 50% off the site the pass holder occupies (concessionaire-run sites).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/alvarado-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-26

note: Sangre de Cristo foothills above Westcliffe (San Carlos RD, Pike-San Isabel NF), at the edge of the Sangre de Cristo Wilderness; lower level for tents and RVs, walk-in tent sites up top, equestrian sites in the middle; some sites beside Alvarado Creek. Last ~2 miles on dirt/gravel (CR 141). Concession-run (ExplorUS). --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30 (2026 and 2027), no hookups, 50 sites to 45 ft, reservable on recreation.gov. Added season early May - late Sept (05-08 to 09-26), reservable season 05-15 to 09-19, some sites always FCFS, 4-day cutoff, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums, 14-night limit, vault toilets, hand-pump water, no dump, senior/access 50% stated. Season close changed 09-19 -> 09-26. No current alert affects the campground or CR 140/141.
flags: Entry phone is empty. The Forest Service page gives San Carlos Ranger District 719-269-8500; recreation.gov also gives (719) 489-2034 'for facility specific information'. The campground is concession-run (recreation.gov notice refers to ExplorUS); the FS page names no concessionaire.
Agency page for the website if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/alvarado-campground (website is the recreation.gov listing).
